workflow.action: Map the residual waterfall against the governing documents
workflow.description: Document each layer from transaction to payout with the document that governs it and the events that move it
workflow.gate: one real merchant's month walks from gross volume to agent payout with every layer's governing document named

workflow.description: Tie every merchant on the report to records, class discrepancies, and escalate in writing
workflow.artifact: reconciled residual ledger with discrepancy log
workflow.gate: the month closes with all merchants accounted for and every discrepancy classed and escalated inside the dispute window

workflow.description: Compute net residual after serve cost per merchant with volume trend and fee mix
workflow.gate: every merchant carries a score with inspectable inputs and a trend, not a book average

workflow.action: Tier the book and flag concentration
workflow.description: Assign tiers from margin, tenure, vertical, risk; flag outsized accounts
workflow.gate: each merchant holds one tier with recorded inputs and a defined service cadence; concentration flags are set

workflow.action: Map attrition drivers and wire the early-warning watchlist
workflow.description: Classify past exits by driver, then wire leading indicators with per-merchant seasonal baselines
workflow.artifact: driver-classified exit log and live watchlist
workflow.gate: each watchlist signal maps to a driver hypothesis and a response window; seasonal merchants carry baselines

workflow.action: Codify the ethics boundary and script the save play
workflow.description: Write the forbidden-tactics boundary first, then the sequenced save that operates inside it
workflow.artifact: save playbook with embedded ethics gates
workflow.gate: the play sequences diagnose-before-offer and statement-verified claims, and every boundary line is testable against a sampled conversation

workflow.action: Design support economics and first-call triage
workflow.description: Cost interactions, set tier service levels, and map issue classes to owners with escalation contacts
workflow.artifact: triage and escalation matrix with tier service levels
workflow.gate: sampled tickets land with the right owner at the tier's response level and routed issues carry follow-through

workflow.action: Launch chargeback education and risk-event shepherding
workflow.description: Deliver the dispute-literacy kit to every merchant and define the shepherd role for holds and flags
workflow.artifact: merchant dispute-readiness kit and risk-event runbook
workflow.gate: materials teach mechanism and classes with the not-advice framing, and the runbook forbids promised outcomes

workflow.action: Run the review cadence with compliance flags and the need-log
workflow.description: Schedule reviews from the tier register; walk statements, check flags, log needs
workflow.artifact: review calendar with completed-review records and need-log
workflow.gate: completion tracks the tier schedule and every review shows a walkthrough, flag check and need-log entry

workflow.description: Read net residual, attrition versus shrink, saves, support load, attach and concentration together monthly
workflow.gate: the review logs decisions taken (or explicitly none) and attrition and shrink appear as separate trends

workflow.action: Value the book and run the sell/hold decision when it arises
workflow.description: Rank the valuation levers with evidence, and compare any offer to retained-stream scenarios under transfer constraints
workflow.artifact: valuation lever memo and decision record
workflow.gate: no multiple is stated as market fact; any considered offer shows the written scenario comparison with professional review documented

priority_rationale: The frame nodes (book-as-asset, residual mechanics, the ethics boundary) come first because every retention, pricing, support and sale decision is reasoned in their terms; reconciliation must precede margin scoring, which must precede segmentation, because each consumes the prior layer's verified output; attrition mapping, early warning and the save playbook build on scored, tiered merchants; support economics, chargeback education and risk shepherding run on the tier system; the review cadence and cross-sell monetize the trusted position only after service earns it; and valuation, sell/hold and sale execution come last because they price and transact the asset every earlier node maintains.

dominance_rules.rule: Disclosure-first honesty dominates every save, reprice, cross-sell and exit tactic
dominance_rules.rationale: the book's durability rests on trust and referrals; one deceptive win costs more stream than it saves
dominance_rules.trigger: any merchant-facing move where deception, omission or pressure would improve the immediate outcome
dominance_rules.action: run the honest version or do not run the move; a save or sale that needs a hidden term is declined

dominance_rules.rule: Document-verified mechanisms dominate remembered percentages in every economic statement
dominance_rules.rationale: rates, splits and multiples vary by agreement, program, network and deal; folklore numbers mislead operators and merchants alike
dominance_rules.trigger: any rate, split, fee level or book multiple is about to be stated or acted on
dominance_rules.action: pull the governing document, current published table, report or offer in hand; if unavailable, state the mechanism and the verification path instead of a number

dominance_rules.rule: The processor's decision authority dominates the operator's advocacy in every risk event
dominance_rules.rationale: holds, reserves, underwriting and termination are the processor's calls; promising outcomes the operator cannot deliver is the fastest trust destroyer
dominance_rules.trigger: a hold, reserve, monitoring-program entry or termination touches a merchant
dominance_rules.action: shepherd fast with documents and named contacts while stating plainly that the decision and timing are the processor's

dominance_rules.rule: Compliance-class verification dominates program convenience and sales momentum
dominance_rules.rationale: surcharge rules, PCI obligations and network requirements are jurisdiction- and network-specific and change; acting on stale specifics exposes the merchant and the operator
dominance_rules.trigger: a surcharge/cash-discount program, revalidation question or network-rule matter arises
dominance_rules.action: flag the obligation class and verify current rules through the processor or network source before advising or proceeding

dominance_rules.rule: Reconciled data dominates report headlines in every downstream computation
dominance_rules.rationale: margin scores, dashboards, valuations and sale comparisons built on unverified payouts inherit invisible errors
dominance_rules.trigger: any analysis or decision is about to consume residual numbers
dominance_rules.action: use only the tied-out ledger; if the month is unreconciled, reconcile first

dominance_rules.rule: Tier economics dominate the loudest-caller instinct in attention allocation
dominance_rules.rationale: unmanaged attention flows to whoever complains, which systematically starves the quiet accounts that fund the book
dominance_rules.trigger: support hours, review slots or save effort are being allocated
dominance_rules.action: allocate by tier register and margin health, with signal-driven overrides recorded, not improvised

dominance_rules.rule: Diagnosis dominates discounting in every save
dominance_rules.rationale: price cuts answer only the price-shock driver; applied to service failures or ownership changes they bleed margin without saving the account
dominance_rules.trigger: a churn signal or departure announcement starts a save
dominance_rules.action: identify the driver first; offer a reprice only when the driver is price and only through the disclosed mechanism

dominance_rules.rule: The education boundary dominates helpfulness in disputes and regulated products
dominance_rules.rationale: the operator teaches mechanisms; specific dispute strategy, legal questions and regulated offerings belong to specialists and licensed providers
dominance_rules.trigger: a merchant asks the operator to fight a specific case, interpret law, or provide a regulated product directly
dominance_rules.action: teach the class and the record-keeping, then route to the processor's dispute team, counsel or a licensed provider with any operator interest disclosed

dominance_rules.rule: Book quality dominates book size in prune, growth and sale decisions
dominance_rules.rationale: buyers and the operator's own economics price margin quality, attrition and concentration, not logo count
dominance_rules.trigger: a keep/cull call, a growth push, or a sale preparation weighs account count against account quality
dominance_rules.action: decide on net-margin and durability evidence; a smaller, cleaner book beats a larger, leakier one

anti_rework_rules.rule: Learn the waterfall and its governing documents before reconciling any report
anti_rework_rules.prevents: months of discrepancy chasing where every variance is a mystery because no one knows which layer legitimately moved

anti_rework_rules.rule: Reconcile the month before scoring margin, updating the dashboard, or modeling value
anti_rework_rules.prevents: rebuilding scores, trends and valuation memos after a payout error is discovered upstream

anti_rework_rules.rule: Score margin health before tiering, and tier before designing service levels
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a support model built on gut-feel importance that must be redesigned when the real margins surface

anti_rework_rules.rule: Codify the ethics boundary before scripting or running saves
anti_rework_rules.prevents: unwinding deceptive saves, retraining habits, and repairing merchant relationships damaged by improvised pressure

anti_rework_rules.rule: Set per-merchant seasonal baselines before turning on churn alarms
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a false-alarm flood that teaches the operator to ignore the watchlist before its first real catch

anti_rework_rules.rule: Deliver chargeback education at book entry, not after the first dispute crisis
anti_rework_rules.prevents: unwinnable disputes lost for lack of evidence habits that cost nothing to install early

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fill the need-log through reviews before constructing any cross-sell offer
anti_rework_rules.prevents: cold pitches that burn the trusted position and convert reviews into declined meetings

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify assignability, consent mechanics and clawback exposure before engaging any book buyer
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a negotiated price collapsing in diligence against transfer terms the agreement fixed years earlier

anti_rework_rules.rule: Maintain the data room continuously as an operations byproduct
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a deal-clock scramble that leaves undocumented claims to be priced as discounts

iteration_protocol.trigger: a residual report discrepancy is found
iteration_protocol.action: freeze downstream scores and memos for the affected merchants, escalate in writing with evidence, and re-run the tie-out after resolution
run the driver-matched save inside the window and log the outcome against the attrition map

iteration_protocol.trigger: a processor fee-schedule, split-exhibit or network cost change lands
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify the waterfall map, classify the change as pass-through or discretionary, re-score affected margins, and prepare disclosure talking points

iteration_protocol.trigger: support load or serve cost shifts materially for a tier
iteration_protocol.action: re-examine the tier's service level and the triage matrix against the retention value the tier protects

iteration_protocol.trigger: a merchant's chargeback trend rises toward program-threshold territory
iteration_protocol.action: re-educate on the driving reason-code family, fix the operational cause, and coordinate current program requirements with the processor

iteration_protocol.trigger: cross-sell attach stalls or a merchant signals offer fatigue
iteration_protocol.action: audit offers against the need-log, pull back any quota-driven pitching, and repair the review agenda

iteration_protocol.trigger: a credible book offer arrives or liquidity needs change
iteration_protocol.action: refresh the dashboard and valuation levers, rebuild the retained-stream scenarios, and run the sell/hold comparison with professional review

iteration_protocol.trigger: a jurisdiction, network or processor rule change touches flagged merchants
iteration_protocol.action: sweep the affected flags (surcharge programs, revalidation, bulletin obligations), verify current rules, and notify merchants with dated notices
